company.shortDescription: BusinessChat is a Marketing Automation Platform, like Mailchimp for WhatsApp. We help e-commerce grow revenues.
company.description: The BusinessChat chatbot can automate responses to Commonly Asked Questions around the clock: shipment tracking, working hours, shop locations, and product list. Let all staff to serve an unlimited number of consumers using your company's official WhatsApp account. Conversations will be sent to all customer care employees via BusinessChat's common inbox to serve them on the WhatsApp channel.
